listing.title: Should I apply? (listing day)
listing.question: Is it worth applying to sell on the first day of trading?
listing.label: Skip for listing gains
listing.reason: How the IPO is built helped it most and financial health held it back. It scored 63 out of 100; the best verdict needs 75.

holding.label: Avoid
